messages:
Sam Keller: Quick sync — enterprise account asks for per-tenant routing controls + hard isolation across regions. Need to decide scope for Q3 initiative.
Anya Patel: TL;DR: customer wants routing by tenant -> region pinning, plus VPC isolation for private deployments. Also wants deterministic failover.
Kevin Zhou: Can we do region pinning via routing policies or need dedicated capacity per tenant? Tradeoffs?
Maya Ortiz: Routing policies cheaper initially (soft isolation) but won't satisfy compliance for some tenants. Dedicated capacity is expensive + infra lead time.
Liz Chen: Suggest classify tenants: 'compliant' vs 'standard'. Compliant get Dedicated or Private + network isolation. Standard on shared pools with tenant-affinity routing.
Sam Keller: Agreed. Need acceptance criteria. Proposal:
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 250ms for regional pinned requests
- Failover: cross-region fallback under 2s for new routing rules
- Isolation: data paths for 'compliant' must not share GPUs/containers with others
Anya Patel: Also add rollout criteria: smoke tests, chaos test (region outage), audit logs enabled, KMS integration tested.
Kevin Zhou: Implementation notes: start with policy engine extension + tagging. Example policy snippet:
```
route {
  tenant: "T-ACME"
  preference: ["us-west-2", "us-east-1"]
  isolation: "soft" # soft|hard
}
```
Maya Ortiz: For 'hard' isolation we'll need per-tenant queues, quota, and reserved GPU pools. Ops: estimate 2 FTE months for infra changes.
Liz Chen: Product ask: expose policy UI in Console + API. Minimum viable UI: per-tenant region dropdown + isolation toggle.
Sam Keller: Prioritization: must-haves for initial launch = routing engine + policy API + monitoring + docs. Nice-to-have = Console UI + automated capacity assignment.
Anya Patel: Customer-driven asks: ACME wants hard isolation + SOC audit. They can contract for Dedicated early if we add reserved pools.
Kevin Zhou: Risks: cost delta, complexity in autoscaling, more frequent capacity fragmentation.
Maya Ortiz: Launch checklist (short):
- e2e test across regions
- performance baseline
- billing/metrics per-tenant
- runbook for failover
- compliance checklist signed
Liz Chen: Suggest phased rollout: 1) Policy API + soft isolation beta with 2 customers 2) Dedicated pool offering for 1 customer 3) Console GA
Sam Keller: Decision needed today: ok to scope Console as beta post-launch? I vote yes. :thumbsup:
Anya Patel: +1
Kevin Zhou: +1
Maya Ortiz: +1
Sam Keller: Cool. I'll update roadmap doc + create RFC with acceptance criteria and capacity estimates. Assign owners: infra=Maya, runtime=Kevin, product=Liz, customer success=Anya.
ops-bot: Created RFC-3287 and assigned to Maya, Kevin, Liz, Anya.
Sam Keller: Thanks all — will post follow-up with timeline and resource ask.
